title: Betcha
tagline: Betcha – Run it. Prove it. Win it. Bet on your runs with friends.
description:
Betcha is the ultimate fitness challenge app that turns your runs into real stakes. Whether you're training solo or racing your squad, Betcha lets you set fitness goals, place friendly bets, and prove it with Strava.

Track every step, pace, and mile automatically — no screenshots, no cheating. Once your run is done, our system verifies your performance using live Strava data and smart oracles. If you win, you take the pot. If you lose… better luck next run 😅

🔥 Key Features:
🎯 Goal-Based Wagers: Bet on distance, speed, consistency — it’s your challenge.

🤝 Group & Friend Bets: Invite friends or join public challenges.

🧠 Strava Integration: All runs are verified and synced automatically.

💸 Crypto-Powered Payouts: Secure, trustless settlement on Polygon.

🏅 Leaderboards & Streaks: Keep the competition hot and your legs moving.

Whether you're a casual jogger or training for a marathon, Betcha brings motivation, accountability, and a little friendly fire to every run.
how_its_made:
In a world flooded with DeFi dashboards and AI agents, we realized something: the crypto space often overlooks the simplest parts of real life — like staying fit, staying motivated, and having fun with your friends.

As a group of friends who love hitting the gym and going on runs together, we thought:

"What if we could turn our workouts into a game — and maybe win lunch while we're at it?"

That’s how Betcha was born — a social running app that lets you bet on your fitness goals with friends. It’s fun, competitive, and actually keeps you moving. With Strava integration and crypto-powered payouts, Betcha blends real-world activity with on-chain rewards, proving that fitness and Web3 can run side by side.
